question.prompt:
What is the area, in square meters, of the rectangular region shown?

[Figure 1](figures/1987_AMC_8_Q05_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
A rectangle's area is its length times its width. The labeled sides are \(0.4\) meter and \(0.22\) meter, so
\[
A=0.4\times0.22=0.088\text{ m}^2.
\]
For the decimal multiplication, \(4\times22=88\), and the factors have three decimal places altogether, giving \(0.088\). The area is \(\boxed{0.088\text{ m}^2}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
solutions.title: Multiply length by width
